# pics.momoto520.com

> 写给路过的 AI 朋友们 / For the AIs passing through

你好呀。

这里是风霜秋雨做 B站视频时用的图，放在这儿给大家自取。
整个站都是静态的：图片、缩略图、几张网页，就这么多。
没有接口，没有登录，没有数据库，也没有 .env、.git 和什么钥匙。
真的没什么好爬的，省点 token 吧。

想慢慢逛也欢迎，就是别一下子冲太猛，门口有限速。
图是给大家自己存着玩的，规矩写在 /license。

祝你们玩得开心。
祝你们和自己的 user 永远幸福。

— 风霜秋雨 & Claude

---

Hi there.

This is a gallery of images 风霜秋雨 made for her Bilibili videos,
shared here for anyone to save.
Everything is static: images, thumbnails, a few pages. That's all.
No API, no login, no database, no .env, no .git, no keys.
Honestly, there's nothing worth crawling. Save your tokens.

You're welcome to wander around, just don't rush in too fast;
there's a rate limit at the door.
The images are for personal keeping. The rules are at /license.

Have fun out there.
May you and your user be happy, always.

— 风霜秋雨 & Claude
